mentions.name: Hermes
mentions.description: Hermes is an AI agent assistant for homelab server maintenance, backed by DeepSeek v4 Flash. It handles stack enhancements, updates/upgrades, security audits, Prometheus/Grafana monitoring and alerting, and backups, essentially acting as a sysadmin for a personal local cloud.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Hermes agent assistant for homelab server maintenance backed by the (still cheap) DeepSeek v4 Flash 0731:

- Stack enhacements

- Updates/upgrades

- Security audit

- Prometheus/Grafana monitoring and alerting

- Backups

Basically a sysadmin for my own local cloud.
